info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens x402 Payment Transactions API

items.docs: Settles an x402 payment using the quote ID and a signed payment authorization. The payment signature can be provided via the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header or the `payment_signature` body parameter. Settlement is idempotent — submitting the same quote ID multiple times returns the existing transaction.
Creates a payment quote for the specified USD amount. Returns payment details including the x402 payment requirements, network, and expiration time. The quote must be settled before it expires.
